quirks.description: Startup can hang before War3Log opens: no window, under 3% CPU, 9 threads, about 300 MB. On 20 October 2026 clone-a hung on all 6 launches whose Battle.net ran as a client service and on a second launch from the same Battle.net; 3 of 4 first launches, clicked Play in a Battle.net started from a shell, reached the menu. A 16 MiB stack limit and fsync off did not prevent it. Doctor reports a hung startup; the cause is open.
